notes:
Inbound SMB lead (self-serve trial started 2026-02-18). Early discovery, heavy focus on data privacy/retention. Shorthand below:

- 2026-02-18: trial signup via hosted API (free credits). Low volume: ~5k tokens/day expected during POC.
- 2026-02-26: intro call (FF id ff_20260226_call_8312). Attendees: CEO (L. Hargreaves), Eng lead (M. Ortiz), Jordan (AE), Riley (SE).
- Key ask: how long do you keep prompts/logs? Is there an opt-out or per-customer/per-user deletion API? Quote from CEO: "We cannot keep customer prompts longer than 30 days, and some customers will require deletion on demand."
- Specific questions: are prompts stored in plaintext in logs? Is there masking/redaction option? Does caching/kv-cache persist prompts? Where are logs stored (region) — they want EU residency for EU customers despite being NA HQ.
- Security: require SOC2, SSO/SAML, KMS for encryption at rest (customer-managed ideally), audit logging for API calls. Need retention controls that can be set per-tenant.
- Compliance flow requested: sample retention policy + sample SLA for data deletion; diagram of logs path (ingest -> runtime -> storage) with retention TTLs for each queue.
- POC plan agreed: 2 week trial using hosted API, measures: latency p95 < 350ms for chat flows, token cost analysis vs projected monthly usage, verify deletion API removes logs within X hours.
- Action items assigned:
  * Jordan: send retention FAQ + sample policy (by 2026-03-12).
  * Riley: prepare mini-arch diagram showing where prompts are persisted and for how long (include cache TTLs, KV cache behavior) — due 2026-03-15.
  * Legal: prepare draft data processing addendum (DPA) — asked to loop in after SE notes.
- Risks / blockers: legal insists on a hard guarantee for prompt deletion & proof for audits; product needs to confirm per-request opt-out flag to avoid logging; they asked about log export and whether logs include full prompt text or only embedding/hash.
- Notes from call: they were open to hosted API if we offer a clear retention default (30 days), opt-out flag, and ability to scoping logs to not store sensitive fields. "If you can guarantee deletions and give us a deletion API we can go forward with mid-market pricing", said M. Ortiz.
- Support tickets: opened REDW-4128 for engineering to confirm KV cache ttl and whether KV snapshots are persisted to long term storage.
- Next meeting: legal + engineering deep-dive planned week of 2026-03-22 to finalize DPA and POC acceptance criteria.

Short summary for AE notes: good fit for Hosted API (SMB, self-serve) if retention/opt-out controls delivered quickly. High chance to convert to paid within 3 months if deletion API and KMS options provided.
